title: Dragonfly Fairy Blossom
description: A large iridescent dragonfly fairy with long flowing pink and orange ribbons trails behind her as she flies toward a massive exploding pink, orange and yellow flower. Smaller fairies flutter around her against a dreamy blue sky with yellow flowering branches on the left.
prompt: A large iridescent dragonfly fairy with delicate wings and long flowing pink and orange ribbons streaming behind her, flying across a dreamy blue sky toward an enormous vibrant pink, orange and yellow exploding flower. Smaller fairies flutter around her. Yellow flowering branches with blossoms appear on the left side. Whimsical fantasy style with visible brushwork, splashes, and decorative swirls.
